text:
Published my first Grok Bot template

Discogs-Bot for collectors — signed-in session, scripts you can re-run:

• Search collection, wantlist, marketplace
• Wantlist vs listings under a max price + price suggest
• Export, find dupes, filter by label / year / format
• Sleeve photo or barcode/cat# → release match
• Folders, artist discography, compare pressings
• Add/remove collection & wantlist (confirm)
• Cart + orders (cart needs hard confirm)

Import: https://x.ai/bot/m5Xjk7EhNokKF49YF9XuW

Scripts: https://github.com/alexhawat/bots-agents-skills/tree/main/grok_bots/discogs-bot
@bot
